title_as_printed: Isopiestic molalities m and the corresponding osmotic coefficients phi for {(1-y)NaHSO4 + yNa2SO4}(aq); m0 = 1 mol kg-1
pressure_note: not stated (isopiestic equilibrium at the water vapour pressure of the solutions)

value.what: total stoichiometric molality (mol of NaHSO4 + Na2SO4 per kg water) of the test mixture, printed as m/m0 with m0 = 1 mol/kg

value2.what: molality of the NaCl reference solution in isopiestic equilibrium

composition.other_species: NaHSO4 (out-of-scope species) in the mixture (1-y)NaHSO4 + y Na2SO4; y = 0.3500, 0.5000, 0.6500 set by group rows as composition.constant.y_Na2SO4; y presumably the stoichiometric mole fraction of Na2SO4 in the salt mixture (paper does not give an explicit definition; text only says experimental samples were mixed from H2SO4(aq) and Na2SO4(aq)); m is the total stoichiometric molality of the mixture. Reference: NaCl.

skip_rows.reason: label rows: temperature blocks and y blocks

extra_unmapped: phi calculated by authors from phi = 2 m_ref... eq (1): phi_x = 2 m_r phi_r / (3 m_x) with stoichiometric 3-particle convention (phi derived_by_authors)
conversion_needs: osmotic coefficients assume complete dissociation into three particles for both Na2SO4 and NaHSO4 (stoichiometric)
notes: Layout: the printed table has three y blocks side by side (phi, m/m0 for y=0.35, 0.50, 0.65) plus a shared NaCl column. Stacked here as: T label row, then for each y a label row followed by the (phi, m/m0, m(NaCl)/m0) rows of that block; NaCl value repeated for each block where the printed row has an entry for that y. Printed lines with an empty cell for a given y simply have no row in that y block (all printed lines are covered: 25, 23, 19, 26, 21 lines per temperature). Pairs of closely spaced replicate rows are genuine. Anomaly as printed: T=443.32 K, y=0.35, row phi=0.4905 m/m0=1.8944 (NaCl 1.5337) is out of sequence/trend (neighbours 0.5653 at m 1.2266 and 0.5608 at m 1.6928); other y blocks at that NaCl molality have m about 1.67; likely a misprint in the source, kept as printed. The 498.19 K block continues on page 585 without a repeated temperature heading.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: CSV data row 137 (T = 443.32 K, y = 0.35: phi 0.4905, m/m0 1.8944, m(NaCl)/m0 1.5337) is out of line with its neighbours (0.5653/1.2266 and 0.5608/1.6928, NaCl 1.5649); the three printed numbers are mutually consistent through the osmotic-coefficient equation (implied phi 0.909 against 0.910 for the neighbour), so the point is kept as printed and flagged as a suspected source outlier. The T label rows are repeated into every y label row (T.constant) because the loader applies only the latest label row.
